comparison.objective: Set and prove a drill-press depth stop, versus set and prove a shock absorber's damping adjustment.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a captive catch while adjusting a positive stop, then apply downfeed loads; candidate adds recessed hex-key unlocking, collar tuning, bounded relocking torque, and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Two repeat depths around 10 mm under 8 N and 12 N with spindle return versus two safe energy-bearing stops within stroke/rebound/overload limits plus a witness-torque drift check.
comparison.reason: This is the closest record because both adjust a retained machine setting and verify it twice. The candidate nevertheless tests dynamic energy dissipation and fastener-retained calibration rather than static depth arrest. No spec versions are present; allowable repeat-depth tolerance is not explicitly stated.
